title: `bb run` without --apply spawns nothing
question: is the dry run actually dry — does it say so, and does it stay at rc 0 without spending?
rule: README: every verb is a dry run until --apply. Only `run` and `bridge send` can spend tokens.
With no routed plan `bb run` exits 2 and says what is missing; it never spawns either way.

steps.name: run reports and spawns nothing, whether or not a plan is routed
steps.run: node bin/bb.js run; rc=$?; test $rc -le 2 && echo "did-not-spawn rc=$rc"

steps.name: the contract is stated where a reader will see it
